programs.title: Hurricane Katrina: Race Against Time
programs.desc: After the hurricane, it turned out that the worst-case scenario had come true - almost all flood embankments were broken, which led to 80 percent of the city being flooded.Rescuers and ordinary citizens rushed to help those in need.Many people had to escape from home in search of shelter.As the water level rose, the incompetence of authorities at all levels, including the government, came to light.The late response of the services was later the subject of an investigation.

programs.title: Lawless Island
programs.desc: The inhabitants of Prince of Wales Island fish, hunt and collect firewood.They have no roads, police or offices, but are threatened by wolves and bears.However, no one is thinking about returning to the city.

programs.title: Mutant Weather
programs.desc: The program presents new weather phenomena caused by climate warming.They cause surprising changes in the world around us, to which we cannot adapt so quickly.
